Statistical Analysis Project

Project Summary
This project presents an end-to-end data analysis performed in R, focusing on exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, and data visualization.


Key Objectives & Findings

Data Wrangling: Processed and cleaned datasets using tidyverse.
Statistical Modeling: Conducted regression analysis and hypothesis testing to evaluate key variables.
Visualizations: Created custom data charts using ggplot2.
